name: pintag-listings-visibility-tests
description: Regression coverage for the ONE rule that matters most on listings.html: a listing that exists in the database must be visible on first page load. Added after a production incident where the public site collapsed to a single visible listing -- every other row was fetched successfully and then discarded client-side by the default-on 'Available Only' filter (currentAvailOnly, flipped to true in commit 9eccd79). Nothing was missing from the database and no query/RLS/join had changed.
